reason: This plugin is primarily a user-interface enhancement for the DSH web chat experience, centered on in-conversation workflow features (selection-based quote insertion and an embedded temporary chat panel) with an additional external web ask popup path. Evidence in the repository metadata and README consistently describes these as interactive UI features rather than code-generation, analytics, or backend automation.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DSH 网页对话中提供选中文本引用、临时对话侧边面板和跳转到外部网页问答的界面工具。
summaries.en: This plugin augments the DSH web chat interface with a selection-based quote action, an in-page temporary chat panel, and an external web ask popup flow.

capabilities: Selection toolbar integration for quote workflows in the DSH web composer
In-page temporary chat side panel with message send/stop/clear interaction
Temporary quote marker handling with draft expansion logic
Clipboard-copy behavior for expanded quote content
Popup handoff path to chat.deepseek.com with query prefill

reasons.code: Repository and README describe the plugin as a DSH web UI selection toolbar that adds Quote, Temp chat, and Web ask actions.
README details that Quote inserts markers in the composer and expands them into blockquotes on send.
README describes an in-page right-side temporary chat panel with markdown rendering and controls like stop/clear.
Web ask is implemented as a right-docked popup to chat.deepseek.com with ?q= prefill, making external service interaction part of the workflow.
package.json declares a web client plugin bundle with injected DSH UI slots and no custom runtime dependencies.
